scenes.text: A frequency table counts observations in categories. Add the category frequencies to verify the total.
Which is the highest frequency in [3, 5, 3, 4]? The answer is 5. The maximum entry in the frequency table is 5.
A survey in the class garden records four groups with frequencies [10, 6, 5, 4]. Which is the total frequency? Pause to choose and explain.
